summary.headline: Astrological Codex Entries 452–465
summary.text: Catalog entries 452–465 for a Florentine astrological codex, covering zodiacal oppositions, solstices and equinoxes, birth conditions, lots, eclipses, planetary periods, ascendants, death timing, bodily omens, dreams, marked elements, geography, lunar calculations, and the continuation of John Camaterus’s poem. It also notes the composition of Pythagoras and several tables, including material on the dissolution of the limbs.
